query: 企业风险管理（ERM）框架 企业风险管理（ERM）框架 衡量企业识别、评估、应对与监控综合风险（含战略、运营、财务、合规及ESG风险）的体系成熟度与披露完备性。 2分 全面披露且体系闭环：同时满足以下四项中的至少三项（其中第1项为必要条件）： （1）董事会或下设专门委员会（如风险管理委员会）明确承担风险管理监督职责，并披露年度检讨频率； （2）披露系统化的风险识别与评估流程（如风险清单、风险热力图、量化评估标准）； （3）披露风险应对策略（如风险规避、转移、缓释、接受）及责任归属； （4）披露风险监控与报告机制（如定期向董事会/委员会汇报、内审验证、整改追踪）。 企业管治报告/ESG报告/年报中有明确描述，且内容具体、可验证 1分 部分披露或制度不完整：满足上述四项标准中的1-2项（若仅满足第1项但缺乏后续流程描述，仍为1分），或虽提及风险管理但缺乏具体机制描述（如仅声明“本公司高度重视风险管理”而无具体架构/流程）。 有相关披露但内容不够完整，缺乏可验证的具体信息 0分 未披露或仅形式披露：未披露风险管理相关信息，或仅以“本公司建立了风险管理制度”等笼统表述一笔带过，无任何实质性内容。 无法从公开披露中获取有效信息 企业风险管理 全面风险管理 风险管理委员会 风险偏好 风险热力图 重大风险 三道防线 风险清单 风险应对 ERM 3LOD enterprise risk management ERM risk committee risk appetite risk heat map principal risks three lines of defence risk register risk response 3LOD 董事会或风险管理委员会如何监督并披露检讨频率？ 风险识别与评估流程（清单、热力图、量化标准）是什么？ 风险应对策略与责任归属如何规定？ 监控报告、内审验证与整改追踪如何运作？ 是否覆盖战略运营财务合规及ESG综合风险？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '企业风险管理（ERM）框架'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 董事会或风险管理委员会如何监督并披露检讨频率？ 风险识别与评估流程（清单、热力图、量化标准）是什么？ 风险应对策略与责任归属如何规定？ 监控报告、内审验证与整改追踪如何运作？ 是否覆盖战略运营财务合规及ESG综合风险？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有单一气候风险段落；仅有网络安全专题；仅有“重视风险管理”口号；仅有内控自我评价无ERM框架；区分：ERM是综合企业风险管理框架；气候物理/转型风险与网络安全治理是专题风险，可作ERM组成部分，但不能单独替代ERM闭环披露。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

For our inaugural Sustainability Report FY2019, we engaged an independent third-party to facilitate our materiality assessment process using a three-step approach. Since then, we have conducted a review of the identified material matters annually. results.text: Transition risks Changes in regulations | As China seeks to achieve carbon neutrality by 2060, many industries have been affected by new regulations such as energy efficiency benchmarks. As Home Control has manufacturing facilities in China, our manufacturing costs may increase as a result. Home Control frequently monitors the regulatory changes under current ISO14001 system requirements. Additionally, we conduct cross function assessments against the latest regulatory changes reported by third-party service agency such as SGS Hong Kong Limited. Changes in consumer expectations | There is a growing consciousness of environmental issues among consumers around the world. Accordingly, we may be affected by an increase in demand for environmentally- friendly products, and would need to ensure that we are well-positioned to turn this into a business opportunity. Currently, one of our key perpetual targets is to meet our customers' environmental requirements related to their products. Home Control has also dedicated an Environmental and Sustainability team to manage customer's environmental requirements on product level. Furthermore, a cross function 'Green Team' has been established for the study and implementation of environmentally friendly technologies and new materials on our product. Physical risks Extreme weather events | The sixth assessment report by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) has indicated that at the current rate of global warming, there would likely be an increased frequency of extreme weather events. For Home Control, this could mean potential disruptions in our supply chains. With regards to the management of supply chain disruption risks due to extreme weather events, Home Control has implemented/in the process of implementing the following: • Contingency plans to buffer from the effects of sudden bad weather events. The addition cost of production from contingency plan will be included in the Bill of Materials (BOM). • Supply risks assessment and tracking system that has been developed to help monitor and detect abnormal situation.

results.text: In addition, we have a Business Continuity Plan (BCP) that outlines the procedures that we will follow in an emergency, and the roles and responsibilities of a dedicated BCP team that we call our Subcon Transfer Team. The Subcon Transfer Team will first identify and prioritise critical products based on the impact of disruptions in terms of revenue, expenses, and intangible losses. They will then present the key risks and actions to be taken to the business team. The business team will approve the plan and allocate the required financial resources. Thereafter they will execute the plan, with the business team monitoring the progress and handling communications with customers, suppliers, investors and employees.

results.text: We are open, honest and ethical in all our dealings, and do not employ corrupt practices such as bribery or money laundering. Only gifts or hospitality that are reasonable and proportionate can be accepted or offered, and we do not make facilitation payments to speed up or secure the performance of a routine government action. Commission payments to business partners must also be justified by clear and demonstrable services they have rendered. With respect to money laundering, we track suspicious transactions such as payments between unknown entities through an excessive number of intermediaries, high-value cash transactions, or payments made or received by suspicious entities or involving high-risk countries. Any employee who suspects any such case has an obligation to report this to our compliance officers.

results.text: We conduct regular audits and reviews of our objectives and targets to achieve continual improvement of our OHS management system, and our OHS policies are communicated to all persons working for or on behalf of the company. Quarterly, at our business review meeting, we review the OHS statistics of our manufacturing partner factory. Our Human Resources office in China works closely with the Human Resources team of our manufacturing partner factory to ensure accurate tracking and reporting of work injuries and man days lost.
